faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the District Court Yadgir Typist recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the District Court Yadgir Typist posts is 30 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Typist posts in District Court Yadgir?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies for Typist and Typist Copyist posts released by the District Court Yadgir.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Typist posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 18 years and the maximum age limit is 40 years for all posts, with applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Typist posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed SSLC or equivalent, PUC or a three-year Diploma, along with Senior Grade Typing in Kannada and English.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary structure for the selected Typist candidates?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Typist posts will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 34100 to Rs. 67600 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the District Court Yadgir Typist recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates can apply online through the official website of the District Court Yadgir on or before the last date of application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the General category candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General category candidates is Rs. 200.

faq.question: Q8. What are the different categories for which application fees are specified?
faq.answer: Application fees are specified for General, SC/ST/Category-1/PWD, and Category-2A/2B/3A/3B candidates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Typist posts?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Typing Test in Kannada and English, followed by an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the "Important Links" section of this article.
